artifacts.query:
FOR d0 IN reviews
  COLLECT score = d0.score INTO qp_group = 1
  LET review_count = LENGTH(qp_group)
  SORT score DESC
  RETURN { score: score, review_count: review_count }
artifacts.answer: 各评分等级的评论数量按评分从高到低排列如下：5分有57328条，4分有19142条，3分有8179条，2分有3151条，1分有11424条。共返回5个评分等级。

artifacts.query:
FOR d0 IN orders
  FILTER d0.purchased_at != null
  FILTER DATE_YEAR(d0.purchased_at) == @value_0
  COLLECT month = DATE_MONTH(d0.purchased_at) INTO qp_group = 1
  LET order_count = LENGTH(qp_group)
  SORT month ASC
  LIMIT 12
  RETURN { month: month, order_count: order_count }
artifacts.answer: 2018年共有10个月存在订单创建记录。代表性数据为：1月7269个订单、2月6728个订单、3月7211个订单。结果显示9月和10月的订单量显著较少（分别为16和4个），且预览中未包含11月和12月的数据。

artifacts.query:
FOR d0 IN products
  FOR e0 IN contains
    FILTER e0._to == d0._id
    FOR d1 IN orders
      FILTER d1._id == e0._from
  COLLECT product_key = d0._key INTO qp_group = 1
  LET sales_count = LENGTH(qp_group)
  SORT sales_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
  RETURN { product_key: product_key, sales_count: sales_count }
artifacts.answer: 按订单商品项数量计算，销量最高的10个商品已返回。结果共10条记录，前三名商品的销量分别为527、488和484。

artifacts.query:
FOR d0 IN products
  FOR e0 IN contains
    FILTER e0._to == d0._id
    FOR d1 IN orders
      FILTER d1._id == e0._from
  COLLECT product_id = d0._id INTO qp_group = { metric_0: e0.price }
  LET total_sales = SUM(qp_group[*].metric_0)
  SORT total_sales DESC
  LIMIT 10
  RETURN { product_id: product_id, total_sales: total_sales }
